_comment_resolved_limitation: CONFIRMED FIXED via a real run: a full mutation-testing pass now completes successfully (79.42% overall mutation score — 1261 killed, 362 survived, 186 timeout, 13 no coverage, 3 errors, in ~55 minutes). Previously crashed partway through the initial dry run with '[vitest-pool]: Failed to start threads worker' across many test files simultaneously. Root cause, now confirmed rather than just suspected: this package's own vitest.config.ts uses the identical '@/core' alias (resolving to the sibling packages/core/src) that was also the root cause of an equivalent Vue package failure — Stryker's default sandboxing only copies the current project directory into its temp sandbox, with no awareness that a path alias reaches outside it, so packages/core was absent from this package's own sandbox too. The `files` option below (adding an explicit `../core/src/**/*.ts` glob, alongside this package's own default file set) is the confirmed fix. The competing Windows-long-path theory raised earlier turned out not to be the (or at least not the whole) cause, since this now passes on the same Windows machine unchanged otherwise. The 3 'errors' in GridItem.tsx and the 362 survived mutants are real, substantive mutation-testing findings of their own — worth triaging separately, not a sign this config is still broken.
